description: Differences caused by the stage0 buildroot (docs/stage0.md, 'Every stage0 hack'). Extend this from per-SRPM allowlists of packages built with stage0.buildStage0 / buildrootFull.

rewrite.reason: stage0 has no annobin plugin: macros.stage0 sets %_annobin_gcc_plugin %{nil}, which empties exactly this token of %optflags
stage0's rpmbuild links nixpkgs' libmagic 5.47 (Rocky: file-5.45), which appends the original size to gzip descriptions (FILECLASS only, not content)

allow.reason: stage0: no annobin plugin, so no .annobin.notes
stage0: no annobin plugin (official objects carry its build attribute notes)

stage0's rpmbuild links nixpkgs' libmagic 5.47 (Rocky: file-5.45), which describes ld.so-style static-pie objects as 'dynamically linked' (FILECLASS text only; PIE/INTERP/dynamic properties are compared by the elf.* checks)
